headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:
今日共收录243篇AI新闻，分类分布：学术研究164篇, 开源项目41篇, 模型发布30篇, 产品/API8篇。热门标签：Agent（55篇）。其中8%的文章有多来源交叉验证。

▸ unslothai /unsloth：Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models, including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4

▸ ToolJet /ToolJet：ToolJet is the open-source foundation of ToolJet AI - the enterprise app generation platform for bui

▸ akitaonrails /ai-memory：Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agen

▸ cathrynlavery /diagram-design：29 editorial diagram types for Claude Code. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows, no Mermaid-slop.

▸ MakazhanAlpamys /Soup：Fine-tune LLMs from one YAML. Layer streaming trains an 8B model on a 4 GB laptop GPU.
